changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: create or alter view [dbo].[OrganizationResourceDetail] as select O.OrganizationID, coalesce(ORG.Name, 'Global') as OrganizationName, O.ResourceID, R.FirstName, R.LastName, R.LastLoggedInOn as DateLastLoggedIn, R.Email, case R.[State] when 1 then 'Active' else 'Inactive' end as [Status], O.Accepted, O.DateAccepted from OrganizationResource O left join Organization ORG on ORG.ID = O.OrganizationID inner join reporting.Global_Resource R on R.ResourceID = O.ResourceID
